claim_boundary: Audit uses existing artifacts and fast mission quick-screen only. It is not final aircraft sign-off and does not replace SU2, detailed FEM, propeller, controls, or manufacturing audits.

nearest_candidate_best_fast_model.manufacturable_read: largest quick-screen power improvement found, but CL band is high_but_possible and requires upstream reselection

power_improvement_gt_5_to_8_pct.engineering_read: Best nearby quick-screen candidate improves required power by less than 5 percent and has no downstream geometry/CG/torsion/release chain.

weight_improvement_gt_2_to_3_kg.engineering_read: No alternate candidate carries a comparable structural mass, splice, rib, tail, CG, or rebalance ledger. Do not credit weight improvement from Stage-0 seeds.

unrecoverable_trim_cg_torsion_or_structu.engineering_read: Release artifacts retain managed CG pass, tail trim/stability pass, bounded physical twist below 3 deg, and P1 local load-path readiness for coupon/local FEM. Uncompensated CG remains rejected.

mission_fail.engineering_read: When release mass and tail CD0 charge are pushed through the Stage-0 quick-screen, margin is negative by about 9 W at 6.6 m/s. This is a power-budget warning for WO-006/WO-007/WO-008, not explicit dominance evidence because the comparison is fast-screen only and Baseline A was released as a team package, not final mission sign-off.

manufacturable_discretization_forces_maj.engineering_read: Baseline span rounds to 34.3 m or 34.35 m with negligible power change; 0.30 m rib basis and 3 m structural splice path are already documented. Full smoothness/manufacturability audit remains WO-004.
